description: Issue #35 stage 1, V2 gate (golden master): the RPG III legacy programs and their fixed-form RPG IV conversions (src/legacy/qrpgle112, HAND CONVERSION - UNVERIFIED until part05-lgcvt has produced and the author has compared the real CVTRPGSRC output) must print the SAME lines. ORDER (one wrapper job): gate (LGPRE: DBVER must be 1 and TXLEGLNG must not be *RPGLE, else the wrapper jumps to DONE and nothing else runs), RUNTXRESET, then (A) RPG III build exactly as verify/part08-05-legacy-baseline (DLTPGM, CRTRPGPGM JU0300 and ZA0500 from the AS-SHIPPED src/legacy/qrpgsrc sources, not the ticket-3 ZA0500; TK0100; the FIXED solutions/05-13/ju0900c-ticket1.clp as JU0900C), CALL JU0300 (FTOK in *LDA blanked), CALL JU0900C PARM(*TEST lib); (B) DLTPGM and CRTBNDRPG over the SAME names JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100 from QRPGLE112 members (CHGPFM SRCTYPE(RPGLE) first, OPTION(*EVENTF) so the compile events land in VFYEVF), the same two calls again; (C) hang-prone steps last: the ORIGINAL src/legacy/qclsrc/ju0900c.clp (LEN(3 0), ticket 1) compiled as JU0900C and run against ZA0500 once as RPG III, then once as RPG IV; (D) restore: RPG III JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100, the fixed JU0900C, TXRESET. If (C) hangs, (D) does not run and the library keeps the RPG IV ZA0500 and the unfixed JU0900C: rerun the restore steps by hand. WHERE TO LOOK: the printed lines of the programs are in the run section (not spool files, see part08-05-legacy-baseline). There are no markers between the printed blocks; they come in this order: (1) JU0300 RPG III, (2) JU0900C chain RPG III, (3) JU0300 RPG IV, (4) JU0900C chain RPG IV, then whatever the two ticket-1 runs print. The MARK lines in VFYLOG (job log, by sequence number) show which step was running; a missing block together with a FAILED line in VFYLOG for the RUN step explains it. EXPECTED: blocks 1 and 3 identical to each other and to the JU0300 block of verify/part08-05-legacy-baseline/expected/golden-master.md (8 orders, GRAND TOTAL 8, XFOOT OK); blocks 2 and 4 identical to each other and to its ZA0500 block (12 lines, OK 10, SHORT 2). Any difference in text, blank-line count or column is a finding about the conversion: record it, do not adjust the expectation. Compile of the RPG IV versions: not known beforehand. Read the RNS/RNF messages in VFYLOG and the VFYEVF rows (verify/part05-lgcvt records the same for scratch names); if a CRTBNDRPG fails, DLTPGM has already removed the RPG III program, so its CALL fails with an object-not-found style message instead of running stale code. TICKET 1 (job log, both variants): RPG III is known (part05-ju0900c-baseline): RPG0907, RPG9001, CPF9999 unmonitored by JU0900C, then JU0900C: ZA0500 ended abnormally, with no printed line. The RPG IV result is UNVERIFIED (2026-10-01): it may be a different message series (RNQ/RNX/CEE) or no error at all; whatever it is, take it from VFYLOG. The ODP of JUCHUD is closed between runs (CLOF OPNID(JUCHUD)) because a failed run could leave it open. ZAIKOM is read before and after each run into VFYLGZA (collect at the end); all rows of tags A-RESET, B-AFTER-RPG3, C-AFTER-RPGLE must be identical (RUNMODE *TEST). VFYLGOBJ (collect) lists OBJATTRIBUTE and OBJCREATED of JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100, JU0900C, MN0000C at the stages A-PRE, B-RPG3-BUILT, C-RPGLE-BUILT, E-TICKET-E, Z-FINAL: expect RPG, RPGLE (JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100), CLP, and RPG again at Z-FINAL; A-PRE shows the state this batch started from. Prerequisite: TXSETUP and TXLEGACY (RPG III) already ran in the library, tools TXRESET and TXSTATUS exist, TK0100D exists (else it is created from the uploaded source). The batch writes QRPGLE112 (created if missing) and leaves its JU0300, ZA0500, TK0100 members there, and leaves QCLSRC member JU0900U (original JU0900C source). It does not touch TXLEGST or TXLEGLNG. Nothing in this batch has run on hardware (PUB400 unreachable on 2026-10-01).

steps.label: CPLGPRE
steps.cmd: CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/LGPRE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(LGPRE) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: GATE
steps.cmd:
CALL PGM(&LIB/LGPRE) PARM('&LIB')
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 MCH0000) EXEC(GOTO CMDLBL(DONE))

steps.label: LIBL

ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB) POSITION(*FIRST)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: RUNTXRESET

steps.label: MKOBJ

steps.label: MKZA

steps.label: SNPRE
